name: Kahris' Apps
subtitle: Native game ports for iPhone and iPad
description: Work in progress: this catalog is being rebuilt. Native game ports for iPhone and iPad, maintained by Kahris. Game data is not included; each app links to its setup guide. Some apps are designed for iPad only.

apps.name: CaesarPad
apps.subtitle: Caesar III through Augustus, designed for iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Caesar III through the Augustus engine, adapted for iPad with direct touch, interface scaling, map gestures and game-folder import.

Requires files from your own legally purchased Caesar III copy. No game data is included. This is an iPad-focused developer preview; iPhone use is not validated even though the package declares both device families.

Setup and support: https://github.com/chrissotraidis/caesarpad#readme

versions.localizedDescription: First public preview, including the game-folder importer fix. Supply your own Caesar III files after installation.

apps.name: PeonPad
apps.subtitle: Warcraft II through Stratagus on iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Warcraft II on iPad through Stratagus and Wargus, with Metal-backed rendering and touch gestures for classic real-time strategy controls. iPad only.

Requires a complete data.Wargus folder extracted from your own Warcraft II copy on a computer. Copy it to PeonPad's Documents folder through Files or Finder. Game data is not included, and this developer preview has no in-app content importer.

Setup and support: https://github.com/chrissotraidis/peonpad#readme

versions.localizedDescription: First public data-free IPA, with Files-visible game-folder discovery and missing-data guidance. Requires a separately prepared data.Wargus folder.

apps.name: DaggerPad
apps.subtitle: Daggerfall through Daggerfall Unity, rebuilt for iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
The Elder Scrolls II: Daggerfall through the open-source Daggerfall Unity engine, rebuilt for iPad with Metal rendering, touch-first controls, Files-based setup, and keyboard, pointer and controller support. iPad only.

Requires Daggerfall game files that you supply. No game data is included.

Setup and support: https://github.com/chrissotraidis/daggerpad#readme

versions.localizedDescription: First public preview. Supply your own Daggerfall files after installation.

apps.name: Emerald Tablet
apps.subtitle: Pharaoh + Cleopatra through Akhenaten, designed for iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Pharaoh + Cleopatra through the open-source Akhenaten engine, with touch navigation and Apple Pencil support. Designed for iPad; the package also declares iPhone, which is less tested.

Requires files from your own Pharaoh + Cleopatra copy. No game data is included.

Setup and support: https://github.com/chrissotraidis/emeraldtablet#readme

versions.localizedDescription: First public preview. Supply your own Pharaoh + Cleopatra files after installation.

apps.name: RAtouch
apps.subtitle: Red Alert with a touch-first control system for iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
The original Red Alert simulation from its GPL source release, with a touch-first control system designed for iPad. The package also declares iPhone, which is less tested.

Requires compatible Red Alert data that you supply. No game data is included.

Setup and support: https://github.com/chrissotraidis/ratouch#readme

versions.localizedDescription: First public build. Supply your own Red Alert data after installation.
